svg.text: GY15 · Active filter
Gain depends on frequency
First-year degree · ages 18+
The capacitor provides a frequency-dependent feedback path. At higher
frequencies it reduces the feedback impedance and the closed-loop gain.
Your investigation
Predict the corner frequency from Rf and C. Use the AC plot to compare
gain and phase below, near and above that frequency.
This activity
Compare the passive and buffered/active versions of a selected filter
under changed loading. Use a model with adequate bandwidth.
Getting started
Open the Simulation tab and press Run. Select a source or component to
see its values. Read the labelled signals, then change one quantity at a
time. Equal net labels identify connected points.
Explain:
Use an equation, a truth table or a state sequence to justify your
prediction. Include units and discuss the model assumptions.
The model predicts electrical behaviour; it does not replace real practical
measurements.
